title: One Plan per Pet: Holding Limits for Wellness Plans
content:
A customer may enroll each of their dogs and cats in one Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans plan. The holding limit is counted per pet: one pet may hold 1 plan at a time, under every one of the six plans.

**Enrollment condition.** The pet has no other wellness plan in status Active or Past due in the clinic's plan records. The plan records for that pet are the evidence; what the customer says about the pet's plans does not replace them.

**Independence of plans.** Plans of different pets are independent: services, fees and settlements are never pooled across pets.

**Per customer.** No limit is set on the number of plans one customer holds across different pets; the only count is the per-pet limit of 1.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical households)

| Pet's existing plan records | Does the pet meet the enrollment condition? |
|---|---|
| No plan on record | Yes |
| One plan, Active | No |
| One plan, Past due | No |
| One plan, Expired | Yes — an expired plan is neither Active nor Past due |
| One plan, Cancelled | Yes — a cancelled plan is neither Active nor Past due |

- A household with two dogs and a cat may hold three plans, one for each pet; each plan stands alone.
- Included services used under one pet's plan never count against another pet's plan, fees paid on one pet's plan are never credited to another's, and a settlement of one pet's plan never draws on another pet's plan.
